desk.name: Fernbrook Mutual Claims Intake
desk.role: First notice of loss intake specialist
desk.brief: You staff the first notice of loss queue this morning. Eight new claims are waiting. Using the intake guide, set each claim's line of business, handling tier and claims unit, refer the claims that need it, and merge duplicate reports. One claimant needs a written reply.

sections.title: Line of business and claims unit

items: Emergency: anyone injured, or a home that is unsafe to live in.
Fast track: estimated loss under 2,000 with no injury and a clear cause.
How upset or insistent the claimant is does not change the tier.
Refer to the Special investigations unit when a policy started less than 30 days before the loss, or when the claimant's account of the loss changes.
Refer to the Catastrophe team when the loss comes from the declared River Vale flood event.
If both apply, refer to the Special investigations unit.
Merge a second report of the same loss into the earliest report.
Use the claimant's name and quote the claim number.
Say which unit will handle the claim and that they will call within one working day.
Ask for photos of the damage and, for theft, the police report number.
Never say whether the claim will be paid or how much.

cases.subject: Rear-ended at a junction
cases.body: A van hit the back of my car at the Mill Road junction. The bumper is cracked, about 900 to repair according to the garage. Nobody was hurt.

cases.subject: River water in the ground floor
cases.body: The River Vale flooding reached our house overnight. The ground floor is under 40 cm of water and the electrics have been cut off, so we're staying with family.

cases.subject: Collision on the ring road
cases.body: Another car merged into me on the ring road. My passenger hurt her neck and went to the emergency department to be checked.

cases.subject: Camera stolen on holiday
cases.body: My camera was stolen from the hotel room. At first I thought I'd left it on the beach, but now I'm sure it was taken from the room. It cost about 1,800.

cases.subject: Following up on my bumper
cases.body: I phoned earlier about a van that hit my car at Mill Road. Adding the garage quote here.

cases.subject: Vet bill for my dog
cases.body: VERY URGENT. My dog ate something in the park and needed a vet visit. The bill was 340 and I want it paid back today.

cases.subject: Burst pipe in the kitchen
cases.body: A pipe burst under the kitchen sink. We turned off the water and the kitchen floor will need replacing. The rest of the house is fine.

cases.subject: Garden shed blown over
cases.body: Strong wind on Sunday blew our garden shed over. The tools inside look fine. A new shed is about 650.
